title: 2 V 1 Quick Strike Game
description: A continuous half-zone 2-on-1 game with two nets on the half wall. Forwards attack to score while the defender works to transition the puck across to teammates on the opposite side, immediately creating the next 2-on-1.
coaching_points: Play with quick passes and quick shots.
Players away from the puck get open, communicate, and present sticks as targets.
Defenders keep their heads up and transition possession quickly.
Reset immediately when the puck crosses to the opposite side.

title: Special Teams Entry Game
description: A special-teams entry game where five power-play players attack four penalty killers from a static start, then regroup for a second entry. The power play works to gain the line and score while the penalty kill works to force chips, dumps, or clears.
coaching_points: Penalty killers keep sticks on the ice and pressure entries toward low-risk options.
Power-play players create space despite beginning with limited speed.
Attack the blue line with support instead of isolated puck carries.
Keep score to reinforce entry and clear outcomes.

title: Billy Purcell Breakout
description: A breakout progression where a defenseman retrieves a chipped puck, reads which breakout option is available, and connects with two forwards who support low before turning the play into a 3-on-0 rush and zone entry.
coaching_points: Defensemen shoulder-check and lift their eyes before selecting the breakout option.
Forwards work hard underneath the puck and provide wall and middle support.
Use communication and clear passing targets on the breakout.
Carry the same pace into the zone-entry portion of the drill.

title: Sticks In Lanes Game
description: A stationary offensive-zone possession game where the offense must complete passes through the middle before shooting while a smaller defending group protects passing lanes with active sticks.
coaching_points: Offense uses deception and plans the next pass before receiving.
Shoot quickly when a clean lane opens.
Defenders keep sticks on the ice and use short explosive movements to close lanes.
Adjust the number of attackers or defenders to change difficulty.

title: Rondo Circle Passing to 2 on 1
description: A rondo-style passing game where the outside group keeps possession against two defenders. When the defenders win the puck, they immediately become attackers in a 2-on-1 against the player responsible for the turnover.
coaching_points: Passers scan before receiving and keep sticks available as targets.
Use body language and deception to move defenders before passing.
Defenders keep sticks in lanes and anticipate the next option.
React immediately when possession changes and convert the turnover into the 2-on-1.

title: NEHDA 2 Puck
description: A two-puck NewEdge Hockey skill progression that combines repeated passing exchanges with lateral movement, deception, mohawks, cutbacks, and puck protection.
coaching_points: Demand accurate passes and constant communication.
Keep lateral movements crisp and get the eyes up quickly.
Sell the fake with head and body before cutting back.
Move the puck away from the body during mohawks to protect it from pressure.

title: Fullback Puck Possession
description: A figure-eight puck-protection battle around two nets. The puck carrier chooses direction and works around the nets while a pursuer reads cutbacks and tries to eliminate space without losing position.
coaching_points: Puck carrier keeps the head up and uses peripheral vision to track pressure.
Stay tight to the nets so the obstacles help protect the puck.
Use cutbacks purposefully rather than randomly.
The defender remains patient and reads direction changes instead of overcommitting.

title: Decision Time 2 on 1
description: A quarter-ice 2-on-1 decision drill where two attackers exchange through an obstacle and the puck carrier reads a coach or defender before deciding whether to keep the puck and shoot or pass to the teammate.
coaching_points: Make sharp lateral cuts before the drop pass.
Place the drop pass on the receiver's forehand.
Puck carrier reads the defender before choosing pass or shot.
Both attackers stop at the net for rebounds.

title: 3 vs 3 Picket Fences
description: A full-zone 3-on-3 game where attackers try to score on the goalie while defenders must regain possession and carry the puck through one of two gates to finish the defensive rep.
coaching_points: Defenders protect possession instead of blindly clearing the puck.
Use deception and reverses to escape forechecking pressure.
Attackers stay relentless on loose pucks and try to isolate defenders into 2-on-1 situations.
Communicate continuously on both offense and defense.

title: Shoot Around The Traffic!
description: A shooting progression that trains players to move the puck around traffic before releasing. Players work through pull-push mechanics, escape moves, timing, and quick shots around a net used as the obstacle.
coaching_points: Communicate clearly before receiving passes.
Keep the head up and pick a shooting target.
Receive, move, and shoot without unnecessary stickhandling.
Release the puck as soon as the stick clears the traffic.
